title: 差点 Step 4 · Phew, Made It! 差点没 + Good Things
description: With things you want, 没 really flips it: 差点没赶上 = almost missed it — so you caught it, just barely. The mood is relief.

points.title: Good events with 差点没: it DID happen 🎉
points.summary: 差点没 + something you want = it almost didn't happen — so it did, by a hair: 我差点没赶上飞机 = I made the plane, just.
points.body:
Here 没 does its normal job ('not'): **almost didn't** happen → **did** happen.

- 我**差点没**赶上飞机。 I almost missed the plane — I made it. 🎉
- 他**差点没**考上。 He nearly failed — but he got in.
- 我**差点没**认出你来！ I almost didn't recognise you! (but I did)

The feeling is **relief**: phew!

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

**Memory hooks**
- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)

points.title: Relief clues: 幸亏, 还好, 好在, 总算, 好险
points.summary: 幸亏 / 还好 / 好在 (luckily), 总算 (in the end) and 好险 (that was close!) tell you it worked out.
points.body:
- **幸亏** (xìngkuī) / **还好** (háihǎo) / **好在** (hǎozài): luckily.
- **总算** (zǒngsuàn): in the end, at last — 差点没赶上，总算赶上了。
- **好险** (hǎo xiǎn): phew, that was close!

Regret words (可惜, 就差一点) don't fit — they mean the good thing did **not** happen.

**The whole picture: 差点 vs 差点没**

| | 😅 unwanted (摔倒) | 🎯 wanted (赶上) |
|---|---|---|
| **差点** | didn't happen | didn't happen 😢 |
| **差点没** | didn't happen (same!) | **did** happen 🎉 |

**Two questions decide it**
1. Is the event something the speaker **wants** (赶上, 考上, 买到) or **doesn't want** (摔倒, 迟到, 丢)?
2. Unwanted → it **didn't happen**, with or without 没. Wanted → 差点 = didn't happen, 差点没 = **did** happen.

**Memory hooks**
- 坏事加「没」，意思不变 — for bad things, 没 changes nothing.
- 好事加「没」，意思反转 — for good things, 没 flips it.

**Mood words give it away**
- Relief (it went well): **幸亏 / 还好 / 好在** (luckily), **总算** (in the end), **好险** (that was close!)
- Regret (it didn't): **可惜** (what a pity), **就差一点** (just a tiny bit short), **真遗憾** (what a shame)
examples: I very nearly missed it — but I made it in the end.

questions.prompt:
「{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{赶上|gǎnshàng}{飞机|fēijī}。」
Did I catch the plane?
questions.explanation: 赶上 is wanted; 差点没 = almost didn't → I **did** catch it. 🎉
notes: 赶上 is wanted; 差点没 = almost didn't → I **did** catch it. 🎉

questions.prompt: What does 「{他|tā}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{考上|kǎoshàng}{大学|dàxué}。」 mean?
options: He almost took the entrance exam.
He only just got into university.
notes: 考上 is wanted → 差点没 = he **did** get in.
差点 says it was close — not easy.
考上 = pass the entrance exam.
questions.translation: He only just got into university.

questions.prompt:
「{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{认|rèn}{出|chū}{你|nǐ}{来|lái}！」
Did I recognise you?
questions.explanation: Recognising a friend is wanted → 差点没认出 = I **did** recognise you, just. 🎉
notes: Recognising a friend is wanted → 差点没认出 = I **did** recognise you, just. 🎉

questions.prompt: {路|lù}{上|shang}{太|tài}{堵|dǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒmen}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{赶上|gǎnshàng}{火车|huǒchē}，（　）{最后|zuìhòu}{一|yì}{分钟|fēnzhōng}{上|shàng}{了|le}{车|chē}。
notes: 本来 = 'originally' — doesn't fit.
差点 = 'almost' — but you did get on.
可惜 = 'what a pity' — but you got on.
questions.translation: The traffic was terrible — we almost missed the train; luckily we got on in the last minute.

questions.prompt: 「{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{买到|mǎidào}{票|piào}。」 vs 「{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{买到|mǎidào}{票|piào}。」 — who has a ticket?
questions.explanation: Wanted event: 差点 → no; **差点没 → yes**. 好事加「没」，意思反转.
notes: 差点买到 = almost got one → no ticket.
差点买到 = no ticket; 差点没买到 = ticket.
差点没买到 = got one, just.

questions.prompt: The concert sold out right after you bought the last ticket. Which sentence fits?
notes: 差点 goes before the verb.
差点买到 = almost got one — no ticket.
That says you didn't get one.
questions.translation: I almost didn't get a ticket.

questions.prompt: Your friend says 「{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{通过|tōngguò}{考试|kǎoshì}。」 Which reply fits?
options: {别|bié}{难过|nánguò}，{没|méi}{通过|tōngguò}{也|yě}{没关系|méi guānxi}。
notes: They did take the exam.
They passed — no need for comfort.
可惜 means they failed — they passed.
questions.translation: I almost didn't pass the exam.

questions.prompt: What does 「{这|zhè}{道|dào}{题|tí}{太|tài}{难|nán}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{做|zuò}{出来|chūlai}。」 mean?
options: The problem was so hard — I only just managed to solve it.
The problem was so hard I couldn't solve it.
questions.explanation: Wanted + 差点没 → **did** happen: solved it, just.
notes: You tried hard.
Solving it is wanted → 差点没 = you **did** solve it.
'Almost solved it' would be 差点做出来.
questions.translation: This problem was so hard I only just managed it.

questions.prompt: 「{最后|zuìhòu}{一|yì}{秒|miǎo}{才|cái}{进球|jìnqiú}——{我们|wǒmen}{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{赢|yíng}！」 What happened?
notes: 'Lost by a hair' would be 差点赢了.
Winning is the wanted event — and you won.
You played — and scored.
questions.translation: We only scored in the last second — we very nearly didn't win!

questions.prompt: 'I almost couldn't find you! (but I did)' Which sentence says so?
notes: 差点找到 = almost found you — so you didn't.
That says you didn't find them.
差点 goes before the verb.

questions.prompt:
A：{你|nǐ}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{怎么样|zěnmeyàng}？
B：{别提了|bié tí le}，{差点|chàdiǎn}{没|méi}{及格|jígé}。
A：（　）
questions.explanation: 差点没及格 = **passed**, just → 还好，总算过了！
notes: 可惜 means they failed — they passed.
They didn't fail.
They did take the exam.
questions.translation: A: How did the exam go? B: Don't ask — I very nearly failed. A: Well, at least you passed!

questions.prompt: In 差点没 + **good thing**, what does 没 do?
options: It flips it: it almost didn't happen — so it did.
Nothing — it means the same as 差点.
questions.explanation: Good thing: **没 flips it**. 好事加「没」，意思反转.
notes: That's true for **bad** things only.
There's no question word.
No — it's about whether it happened at all.
